name: @emsenn/language-analysis
description: The analysis layer of language: semantic frames (roles, polarity, scope, tense, presupposition, logical form) and discourse analysis (entity linking, reference resolution) over a settled parse.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-boundary/copy-dmts-to-dts.mjs dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".tmp/test-dist/**/*.test.mjs"
